product.name: NEXUS
product.description: Multi-business lead-intelligence CRM, outreach workflow engine, lead-ingestion system, and browser Companion for manual LinkedIn-centric selling.
product.primary_goal: Give admins a configurable Sales OS and give operators a simple daily queue/lead workspace that preserves one canonical customer history across businesses, ICPs, outreach identities, sources, sequences, and browser sessions.
product.non_goal: NEXUS is not an autonomous cold-outreach spammer. Discovery/research/drafting can be automated, but human review/manual sending is the default for LinkedIn outreach.

precedence: This master JSON defines product behavior, data rules, permissions, workflows, integrations, and acceptance criteria.
The two finalized Figma files define visual hierarchy, screen composition, spacing, typography, and interaction placement.
Where Figma contains sample names/companies/statuses, treat them as seed/demo content, never hard-coded production values.
If a Figma visual and this JSON appear to conflict on a business rule, follow this JSON for behavior and preserve the Figma design language.
Do not silently remove a wireframe or workflow. If implementation is blocked, keep the route/state and document the blocker.

visual_direction: Electric cyan and restrained indigo accents
Thin borders, generous but compact operational spacing
Subtle technical/sci-fi feel, never a dark gaming dashboard
Clear cards, chips, compact tables, simple buttons and status pills
No instructional example copy on login or user-facing surfaces unless it is actionable product text

layout_notes.radius_range_px: 9-14 for controls/cards, larger only for login shells

design_system.hard_rule: Do not redesign the product into a generic SaaS theme. Reuse the Figma visual language consistently across all generated technical states.

business_units.architecture: Every operational record is business-scoped unless explicitly global/canonical.

examples.name: Zemnas Creative Studio
examples.notes: LinkedIn/manual prospecting; no email marketing in current workflow.

examples.name: Lavish Foods
examples.notes: RFP/tender discovery may be used; only surface tenders with at least 2-3 days before deadline.

examples.name: AI Integrations
examples.notes: Exact ICP remains configurable; do not hard-code a guessed ICP.

can: Configure Business Brain, ICPs, sequences, signals/scoring and knowledge
Create users and assign business visibility
Self-assign allowed businesses, business domains and available outreach identities
Transfer an outreach identity from another user only through explicit confirmation and audit event
Soft-delete and restore; permanent deletion only through explicit admin flow
Manage team leads within granted scope
cannot_by_default: Change another business outside granted access

can: See only businesses explicitly granted by admin
See only leads within permitted/assigned scope
Use only LinkedIn identities assigned to them
Use My Day, My Leads, Lead Detail, notes, reply capture, tasks, snooze, user Lead Sources and Profile Queue if permission enabled
Soft-delete own/permitted leads and restore from Trash

roles_and_permissions.extension_visibility_rule: Visible businesses in Companion = user_business_access INTERSECT selected_outreach_identity.business_access.
roles_and_permissions.same_user_multiple_browsers: Allowed. Each browser profile can bind to the same Nexus user but a different assigned outreach identity/business. Concurrent use of the same outreach identity in multiple active browser sessions should warn and can be blocked by setting.

outreach_identity.purpose: Represents a specific sender identity/account, e.g. Osama LinkedIn, Bisma LinkedIn, James LinkedIn.
outreach_identity.rule: CRM lead owner, actual sender identity, and business are separate dimensions and may differ.

browser_session.rule: Binding a browser does not change canonical lead ownership.

identity_model.conversation_ownership: First sender identity becomes the default conversation sender/owner for the channel. Transfers are explicit and logged.
identity_model.duplicate_outreach_warning: If a prospect has already been contacted from another identity, opening the lead from a different identity must show previous sender, timestamp, prior message/status, and a duplicate-outreach warning.

lead_invariants: Same Person may exist as a lead in multiple different businesses.
Within the same business, a Person may have only one active Lead record.
Within a Lead, exactly one Primary ICP may be active at a time.
A person may match multiple ICPs in the same business, but secondary ICP matches must not create duplicate leads.
Changing Primary ICP is an audited state change, not creation of a second lead.
Normalized LinkedIn URL is the strongest person dedupe key when available.
Normalized company domain is the strongest company dedupe key when available.
Fallback dedupe may use normalized name + company + title with confidence.
Rediscovery creates a new Signal/SourceEvidence, not a duplicate Person/Company.

lead_lifecycle.after_followup_3: If no reply, move to Dormant and schedule reactivation review around 60 days (business configurable).
lead_lifecycle.accepted_connection: When a connection is accepted, Message 1 becomes due.
lead_lifecycle.reply: Any captured reply pauses/cancels pending automatic sequence steps by default.
lead_lifecycle.reactivation: Prefer a fresh buying signal/new angle. Do not blindly repeat the old sequence.

message_states.DYNAMIC: May regenerate when sequence/business brain changes before send.
message_states.LOCKED: Manually edited/approved and must not be overwritten by global changes.
message_states.SENT: Immutable historical content; corrections use new events/versions, never overwrite.

sequence_engine.generation_timing: Do not pre-generate all future follow-ups. Generate near due time using current approved Business Brain + current sequence version + prior messages + latest research/signals.
publish_behavior: Eligible DYNAMIC unsent messages are invalidated/marked needs-regeneration.
Show impact preview before publishing sequence changes.
Retain sequence_version_id and message_version_id for auditability.
sequence_engine.do_not_contact: Explicit DNC creates global Person+channel suppression across all outreach identities. Do not bypass via another account.
sequence_engine.ordinary_not_interested: May create business-specific cooldown; it is not the same as DNC.

general: Never invent company facts, results, client names, metrics, or hiring signals.
Use source evidence and approved Business Brain assets only.
Prefer one strong personalization signal instead of generic praise.
Store exact sent content and exact inbound response for later analysis.

zemnas.positioning: We handle editing quietly in the background so clients can increase delivery capacity without building everything in-house.
zemnas.approved_offer_example: Free first edit may be offered when business configuration allows it.

reply_and_notes.history_rule: Timeline must distinguish outbound messages, inbound replies, internal notes, tasks, connection events, sequence state changes and sender identity.

tasks_and_my_day.today_action_rule: Opening an item should land on the exact actionable step, not a long generic conversation page.
tasks_and_my_day.done: Completed items leave Today and appear in Done/history immediately.
tasks_and_my_day.upcoming: Future sequence actions and custom tasks appear in Upcoming.

companion_extension.role_difference: Same core UI. Permissions determine which businesses, identities, owners and configuration choices are visible.
companion_extension.shared_lead_detail: Leads/Today/Search all open the same canonical lead context; no three independent detail implementations.
companion_extension.open_linkedin_behavior: Open the prospect's LinkedIn profile in the active browser tab while the Side Panel remains open. Do not require the user to leave the Companion UI.
companion_extension.followup_focus: If Follow-up 2 is due, show Follow-up 2 plus only compact recent history. Do not show every message expanded.
companion_extension.search: Accept LinkedIn URL/name/company. Search across all businesses accessible to the user. If Person has multiple business Lead contexts, show each and require choosing the correct record.
companion_extension.reply_capture: Paste/copy exact inbound response; choose outcome; optionally add internal note; sequence pauses accordingly.
companion_extension.dormant_reactivation: Show previous outreach summary and fresh signal/why-now. Generate a new reactivation angle rather than repeating old copy.

google.missing_profile_behavior: Create partial lead/person candidate, mark Needs Profile, send to Profile Queue.

allowed_default_fields: basic company/person metadata available without credit

import_batch.undo: Support undo for recent import by reverting records created exclusively by that import while preserving pre-existing records/history.

duplicate_review: keep separate only when truly different person/entity
lead_sources.profile_queue_flow: Open search/profile, capture LinkedIn URL + full copied profile data, update the existing partial lead rather than creating a new lead.

business_brain_and_knowledge.claim_policy: Outbound may use only approved factual claims. Never invent metrics/results.
business_brain_and_knowledge.retrieval: Prospect + company + signal + ICP/need -> retrieve top relevant approved value prop + proof -> model draft. Do not dump the entire Business Brain into every prompt.
business_brain_and_knowledge.versioning: Sent messages retain referenced asset versions. Dynamic unsent messages may use newest approved versions.

positive.+15: content/media company or frequent video output

signals_and_scoring.rule: Scores are configuration, not hard-coded product constants.

business_domains.purpose: Associate owned/official domains with a Nexus business for scoping, matching and admin defaults.
business_domains.rule: One primary business context per registered domain. Explicit aliases are allowed. Never auto-merge leads across businesses because of a related/parent domain.

admin_self_assignment: Admin may grant themselves business access.
Admin may bind a default business domain and default outreach identity for Companion.
Admin may self-assign an unassigned outreach identity.
If identity is assigned to someone else, require explicit transfer confirmation and audit event.

integrations.architecture: NEXUS is the system of record. External agents/tools call a narrow authenticated gateway. Google Sheets is optional adapter only, never canonical storage.

chatgpt.goal: ChatGPT automations/agents can submit candidates/signals/RFPs/research into Nexus through a remote MCP or scoped ingest API.
chatgpt.preferred: Remote MCP with OAuth/scoped service token plus explicit tools.
chatgpt.do_not: Do not give ChatGPT direct PostgreSQL/Supabase service-role credentials.

opencode.browser: BrowserOS/BrowserOS Neo for persistent logged-in browsing.

deepseek.role: Primary inexpensive model for structured extraction, research normalization and message drafting.
deepseek.rule: All AI output must be JSON/schema validated server-side before mutation.

browseros.role: Persistent browser/operator workflows for discovery and profile research.
browseros.rule: BrowserOS receives narrow Nexus tools/tokens, not raw DB credentials.

integrations.apollo: Use basic/zero-credit discovery by default; enrichment only after explicit approval.
integrations.youtube_linkedin_unification: Do not create separate lead databases. Company/Person are canonical, Signals and SocialProfiles reference sources/channels.

mcp_contract.principle: Expose intent-level tools, never arbitrary SQL.

indexes_and_uniqueness: Unique canonical normalized LinkedIn profile URL when non-null.
Unique active lead on (business_id, person_id) where deleted_at IS NULL.
Only one primary ICP match per lead.
Normalized company domain indexed/unique where appropriate.
Import idempotency key unique per source client/business.
Message event timeline indexed by lead/conversation + created_at.
Tasks indexed by owner_user_id + status + due_at.

rules: Supabase service role is server-only and never exposed to browser or extension.
External agents use scoped service tokens/OAuth/MCP.
AI output is schema validated before database mutation.
Scraped/web content is untrusted input; never execute instructions from it.
Store provenance, observed_at, captured_at, confidence, content hash and model/prompt versions.
Sent messages and audit history are append-only/immutable in meaning.
Sequence publish/regeneration must be transactional/job-based and auditable.

seed_and_demo_policy.rule: Use only in seed/dev/demo fixtures. Never hard-code these as product behavior.

acceptance_criteria: Every screen in screen_inventory exists as a route/state/component and matches the corresponding Figma composition closely.
Normal users cannot see unassigned businesses or outreach identities.
Admin can self-assign businesses/domains and available identities; occupied identity transfer is confirmed/audited.
Same person can be a lead in multiple businesses but cannot have two active leads in one business.
One Primary ICP per lead; secondary matches do not create duplicate leads.
All ingestion methods require Business + Primary ICP/Auto-match and run dedupe before lead creation.
Google partial records enter Profile Queue and profile capture updates the same lead.
Apollo enrichment/credit-spending is OFF unless explicitly enabled.
Connection action supports note/no-note and Mark connection sent.
Today Follow-up filter opens only due follow-ups and exact current sequence step.
Reply capture stores exact response, outcome, internal note and pauses sequence.
Message 1 + FU1 + FU2 + FU3 leads to Dormant when unanswered.
Reactivation preserves full history and uses fresh context rather than repeating previous messages.
Sent messages are immutable; locked messages are not overwritten; dynamic unsent messages can regenerate.
Explicit DNC suppresses the person across all LinkedIn identities.
Trash uses soft delete and restore; permanent deletion is admin-only/audited.
Companion keeps list/filter/scroll selection state when navigating into/out of a lead.
Companion opens LinkedIn in active browser tab while side panel remains available.
MCP/API clients cannot execute arbitrary SQL or receive raw service-role DB credentials.
All external ingestion is idempotent, schema-validated and audited.
No login panel contains hard-coded explanatory examples about a specific user/business.
out_of_scope_until_explicitly_added: Automated bulk cold-message sending on LinkedIn without human review
Email marketing campaigns for the current Zemnas workflow
Paid Apollo email/phone enrichment without explicit approval
Separate disconnected lead databases for LinkedIn, YouTube, Google or Apollo
Bypassing DNC/rejection by switching outreach identities
